## VSiN Stability Score — as printed

Steve Makinen's Stability Score (pp. 41–44), reproduced exactly. This library does not recompute it, re-weight it, or substitute a TTW score.

| Component | Points | Reading |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Head coach returns | 4 | Returning head coach |
| Offensive coordinator returns | 3 | Returning OC |
| Defensive coordinator returns | 0 | **New DC** |
| Quarterback returns | 0 | **New QB** |
| Returning starters | 0 | 4 returning starters as printed in the table |
| **Total** | **7** | 2025 record 4-8 |

> The guide's own use of this number: it plays on teams with a Stability Score edge of 6 or more in non-conference games in weeks 0–3, and against teams scoring 0–6 in the same window, excluding games with a spread of 30 or more (pp. 40–41).

## VSiN on this hire — The Coaching Carousel Never Stops

*Adam Burke, p. 33. GUIDE CONTENT — TTW reference notes summarising the guide's assessment; the judgement is the guide's.*

Adam Burke starts by clarifying the status: Mortensen isn't a new head coach, per se, as he took over when Trent Dilfer was booted from Birmingham, but he's the full-time man now. He records the audition — 2-4 in his six games, with a big upset of Memphis in his first game at the helm, which may very well have been the deciding factor in just keeping him. He then reaches back for the pattern: the Dilfer hire was out of left field, to say the least, when the players desperately wanted Bryant Vincent to take over the job permanently after he filled in for Bill Clark, but that didn't happen. His verdict on the sequel is blunt — simply elevating Mortensen from OC reeks of being too cheap to make an impact hire.

## SOURCE CONFLICT

**new / returning head coach.** The guide states this three ways and they do not agree: the team page prints “Alex Mortensen - 1st season”; the Stability Score table (p. 44) awards 4 points for a returning head coach, so it treats the position as unchanged; the Coaching Carousel feature (pp. 28–37) lists the programme. All three are reproduced as printed and none is corrected.

**conference placement in the Coaching Carousel.** The Coaching Carousel (p. 33) places UAB in the Conference USA / Independents section, while the team page and the projected standings place the programme in the American. Both are reproduced as printed and neither is corrected.
